summary: Fork is branding-virgin (zero Boss identity) and only 3 commits behind upstream; all 4 fork-only commits are agent tooling, so there is no fork-unique product code to protect yet. Two critical gaps: userData is name-derived (renaming the app silently orphans user profiles) and no data-migration policy exists. Menus already route through t() and app.name, so the real i18n surface is 89 user-visible values across 13 locales x 2 trees, not the 4306 raw occurrences goals.md implied.
warnings: goals.md is factually wrong on two points (10 vs 13 locales; implied existing Boss branding). Plan must size from assessment.md.
Hooks subsystem unavailable (KBD_ORCHESTRATOR_ROOT unset; only archived/worktree copies of hooks.sh and stage-gate.sh found). assess:before/after were NOT fired.
Upstream was fetched into a throwaway ref refs/remotes/_probe/main for measurement; a permanent upstream remote is still a G5 deliverable.
